card.text: Rapidly rotating A-type star 7.68 parsecs away; its photosphere is not imaged here.

introduction.text: Vega is a rapidly rotating A-type star 7.68 parsecs away, wider at its equator than at its poles. Here it is a plain sphere of the same volume.
